comment: What two probe traces of Steam's English ResidentEvil.exe (app 4249100) showed behaving as described (tools/Lockpick.Probe trace, 10 + 5 min, 2026-10-26, owner playing a Jill game from 3:30 of game time: main hall, 1F west, 2F and back, Beretta and shotgun fights, bites, a Green Herb, the item box, pickups). Applied by tools/re1/port_profile.py --live. Fields not listed stay static; mainMenu wasn't shown (never at the title).
session: Jill game, owner, two probe traces

fields.camera: 108 changes, at the camera cuts while walking.
fields.hp: 96 (full) for the first trace; 90, 84, 78, 72, 66, 60 in steps of 6 from bites, then 92 the moment the Green Herb left the inventory.
fields.character: 1 (Jill) the whole trace, with Jill's inventory (inventoryPtr) and health.
fields.gameTimer: Counted from 6 300 to 27 847 frames (3:30 to 15:28 of game time) over 15 min of play.
fields.positionX: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.positionZ: Changes as the player walks (trace context).
fields.inv1: Beretta (0x02), its rounds 15 → 14 → … → 2 one per shot.
fields.inv1Qty: The Beretta's rounds, one fewer per shot, at the moments an enemy's HP fell.
fields.inv3: Shotgun (0x03), picked up with 7 shells, 6 → 0 one per shot.
fields.inv3Qty: The shotgun's shells, one fewer per shot.
fields.equippedSlot: 2 (Beretta), 4 (shotgun), 8 (the Bazooka in slot 8), 7 as items moved.
fields.enemy0Hp: Fell in steps at the moments the Beretta's rounds dropped (0x5B, 0x4F, 0x43, 0x37 …); below zero when the enemy died.
fields.enemy1Hp: Fell at the shots, then below zero (dead).
fields.enemy0Type: Changed with the room (0x22 Barry, 0x02 dog, 0x11 researcher zombie, 0x26, 0x0F plant).
fields.flagRoomItems0: A bit cleared at each moment an item appeared in the inventory (the shotgun, Acid rounds, the Bazooka).
fields.box0: 0x0F0B (Clip x15), the box's starting item; then the Herbicide stored, then empty when it was taken out.
fields.stage: 0 on 1F, 1 after the stairs to 2F, 0 again back down.
fields.inv4: A Clip (0x0B x15) stored in the box, Herbicide (0x26) taken out, the Clip again.
fields.inv4Qty: 15 for the Clip, 1 for the Herbicide.
fields.inv5: Herbicide stored, the Clip taken out, later Acid rounds (0x11 x6).
fields.inv6: Green herb (0x44) picked up; Acid rounds after the herb was used; the Bazooka later.
fields.inv6Qty: 1 for the herb, 6 for the rounds.
fields.inv7: Jill's 8th slot: Acid rounds (0x11 x6) picked up, then the Bazooka (0x07, Jill's grenade launcher) with 6 rounds counting down per shot.
fields.enemy1Type: Changed with the room (0x11 researcher zombie, 0x05 crows, 0x0F plant).
fields.box1: The Clip stored, then empty when it was taken out.

addresses.inventoryPointer: Holds the inventory's address (0xBE9944) during Jill's game.
addresses.inventory: The slots above, as picked up and used.
addresses.itemBox: Its first entries: the box's starting Clip x15, then what was stored and taken out (Herbicide, the Clip).
addresses.actorSlots: Slots 0–5: types and HP above (zombies, dogs, crows, plants hit by the Beretta, shotgun and grenades, then dead).
